leftEvidence.title: Three annual appearances, unleavened bread, sacrificial blood, leaven, and the morning boundary are joined

points.label: Calendar
points.left: Unleavened Bread is one of three annual feasts.
points.right: The feast is restated among firstborn, Sabbath, and three annual appearances.

points.label: Sacrifice
points.left: Blood is not offered with leaven, and feast fat does not remain overnight.
points.right: Sacrificial blood is not offered with leaven, and Passover sacrifice does not remain until morning.

points.label: Surrounding material
points.left: Harvest and ingathering frame the annual cycle.
points.right: Firstborn redemption, rest, firstfruits, and land security surround the feast.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Unleavened bread stands beside firstborn ownership, Sabbath, three appearances, blood, leaven, and firstfruits

payload.tension: The two instructions repeat blood, leaven, appearance, and the morning boundary while placing them in different covenant collections.
payload.title: Annual feast instructions in Exodus 23 and 34
